scope: Second independent fleet-study lot. Twenty-six additional accessible factual contextual records, not forty tasks or twenty-six new hulls. Arcturian Jade is the one newly represented named transport; Hyperion is an additional exact prologue occurrence of a hull already studied later. Twenty-four records are inspection-only with simulation:null.

logisticsMapping.shield: Original abstract reserve budget10, not a canonical shield
logisticsMapping.speed: Original logistics mobility budget3; not ATB actor speed or canonical velocity

inventoryMethod.reviewed: Remaining accessible universe names/descriptions for transport terms, then remaining worlds/zones/equipment/props/lore references, with exact canAccessContent checks and full200-record lot1 exclusion.
inventoryMethod.selection: Conservative curated stock; no claim that every conceivable transport reference in the published fiction has been independently researched or exhausted.
inventoryMethod.shortfallReason: The remaining records are largely rooms, repeated mission/hull anchors, ground installations, unsupported models or references with no authorized period. These do not justify padding to forty.

excludedExamples.reason: Rooms aboard previously referenced vessels; not additional hulls or independently identified vehicles.
Audience-room reference; exact vessel name is explicitly reserved for visual rechecking. Not counted as a new ship.
Mission anchors for the same contextual hulls already represented in lot1; adding another card would duplicate them.
World and survivor-camp references are not treated as a newly available Hugo Gernsback vessel.
Factual reference but no authorized period; no new period is inferred.
Unverified nature and no authorized period; cannot supply a second SR-1 study.
Illustrated or proposed adapted systems, not accessible factual vehicle identities.
Research-installation mission names on Aite do not establish additional spacecraft or transport identities.

futureWorkWithoutInventedHullIds: Deepen existing ship dossiers with independently verified system or cargo constraints while retaining each current record identity.
Add an explicitly original logistics comparison with different reserve-allocation decisions, identified as an exercise rather than a new canonical vessel or narrative voyage.
Research precise original sources before proposing any currently unsupported ship model, interior, period or consequence.
limitations: Distinct record IDs across works identify documentary contexts, not necessarily distinct physical stations or hulls.
Nineteen station dossiers, one derelict, three Normandy systems and one Nomad appearance have simulation:null and a blocking reason.
Normandy consequence tables remain unverified where their source conditions say so; Tali and edition/content conditions remain visible rather than becoming unlocked equipment.
Source IDs and facts are inherited from the existing registry. No new external reading, canonical performance, flight model, ship kit, image or original layout has been verified.
No fuel, weapon, crew, acquisition, pilotage, voyage outcome, campaign progress, victory or reward is granted.
Only the new source module, its tests and this report are produced; original fleet data, catalogues, source metadata, workbooks, UI and historical reports remain untouched.
